import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 12345678;
    static int size, limit;
    static int[] leftSide = new int[1000];
    static int[] rightSide = new int[1000];
    static int[] color = new int[1000];
    static char[][] gridSrc, gridDst;
    static int[][] distSrc, distDst;
    static Bucket[][] buckets;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adjList = new ArrayList[1000];
    static Queue<Point> qq = new LinkedList<>();

    static class Point {
        int x, y, id;
        Point() {}
        Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
        Point(int x, int y, int id) { this.x = x; this.y = y; this.id = id; }
    }

    static class Bucket {
        int[] vals = new int[1000];
        int cnt;
        int active;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        size = sc.nextInt();
        limit = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        distSrc = new int[size + 1][size + 1];
        distDst = new int[size + 1][size + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++)
            Arrays.fill(distSrc[i], INF);
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++)
            Arrays.fill(distDst[i], INF);

        gridSrc = new char[size][];
        gridDst = new char[size][];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            gridSrc[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            gridDst[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();

        buckets = new Bucket[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++)
                buckets[i][j] = new Bucket();

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++)
                if (gridSrc[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Point p = new Point(i, j);
                    bfsSource(p);
                }

        int idx = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(gridDst[i][j])) {
                    int k = gridDst[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) buckets[i][j].active = 1;
                    buckets[i][j].cnt = k;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
                        buckets[i][j].vals[l] = idx++;
                }

        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++)
            adjList[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        idx = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(gridSrc[i][j])) {
                    int k = gridSrc[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Point p = new Point(i, j, idx++);
                        bfsDest(p);
                    }
                }

        System.out.println(maxMatch(idx - 1));
        sc.close();
    }

    static boolean tryAugment(int u) {
        if (color[u] != 0) return false;
        color[u] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < adjList[u].size(); i++) {
            int v = adjList[u].get(i);
            if (leftSide[v] == -1) {
                leftSide[v] = u;
                rightSide[u] = i;
                return true;
            } else if (tryAugment(leftSide[v])) {
                leftSide[v] = u;
                rightSide[u] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int maxMatch(int nodes) {
        Arrays.fill(leftSide, -1);
        Arrays.fill(rightSide, -1);
        boolean changed;
        do {
            changed = false;
            Arrays.fill(color, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; i++)
                if (rightSide[i] == -1 && tryAugment(i))
                    changed = true;
        } while (changed);
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; i++)
            if (rightSide[i] != -1) res++;
        return res;
    }

    static void bfsDest(Point s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++)
            Arrays.fill(distDst[i], INF);
        int i = s.x, j = s.y;
        distDst[i][j] = 0;
        qq.clear();
        qq.add(s);
        while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
            Point p = qq.poll();
            i = p.x; j = p.y;
            if (distDst[i][j] > limit) continue;
            if (gridSrc[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            if (buckets[i][j].active != 0) {
                if (distDst[i][j] <= limit && distDst[i][j] <= distSrc[i][j]) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= buckets[i][j].cnt; k++)
                        adjList[s.id].add(buckets[i][j].vals[k]);
                }
            }
            if (distDst[i][j] >= distSrc[i][j]) continue;
            // up
            if (i - 1 >= 0 && distDst[i - 1][j] > distDst[i][j] + 1) {
                distDst[i - 1][j] = distDst[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i - 1, j));
            }
            // down
            if (i + 1 < size && distDst[i + 1][j] > distDst[i][j] + 1) {
                distDst[i + 1][j] = distDst[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i + 1, j));
            }
            // left
            if (j - 1 >= 0 && distDst[i][j - 1] > distDst[i][j] + 1) {
                distDst[i][j - 1] = distDst[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i, j - 1));
            }
            // right
            if (j + 1 < size && distDst[i][j + 1] > distDst[i][j] + 1) {
                distDst[i][j + 1] = distDst[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i, j + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfsSource(Point s) {
        int i = s.x, j = s.y;
        distSrc[i][j] = 0;
        qq.clear();
        qq.add(s);
        while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
            Point p = qq.poll();
            i = p.x; j = p.y;
            if (gridSrc[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            // up
            if (i - 1 >= 0 && distSrc[i - 1][j] > distSrc[i][j] + 1) {
                distSrc[i - 1][j] = distSrc[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i - 1, j));
            }
            // down
            if (i + 1 < size && distSrc[i + 1][j] > distSrc[i][j] + 1) {
                distSrc[i + 1][j] = distSrc[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i + 1, j));
            }
            // left
            if (j - 1 >= 0 && distSrc[i][j - 1] > distSrc[i][j] + 1) {
                distSrc[i][j - 1] = distSrc[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i, j - 1));
            }
            // right
            if (j + 1 < size && distSrc[i][j + 1] > distSrc[i][j] + 1) {
                distSrc[i][j + 1] = distSrc[i][j] + 1;
                qq.add(new Point(i, j + 1));
            }
        }
    }
}
